sentences.text:
======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Ms. Prabha Mishra, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Gulnar Begum, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Arvind Srivastava
 Oral Order
2 22-03-2023
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Rajeev Nagar P.S. Case No. 87 of 2019 registered under Sections 353, 504, 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120(B) of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3 of the Public Property Damage Act.

Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits that the petitioner had earlier moved for anticipatory bail with two others co-accused persons before this Court bearing Cr. Misc. No.
12002 of 2020 which was dismissed as withdrawn on 22.10.2021.

Now, petitioner has again moved for anticipatory bail before this Court by submitting fresh ground that similarly situated several co-accused persons have already Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.13225 of 2023(2) dt.22-03-2023 been granted anticipatory bail by different Benches of this Court vide orders dated 17.12.2020,
02.12.2020, 01.12.2022 and 21.12.2022 passed in Cr. Misc. Nos. 30317 of 2020, 29008 of 2020,
49429 of 2022 and 58199 of 2022 respectively.

Having considered the facts and circumstances of the case, let the above named petitioner be released on bail, in the event of arrest or surrender before the learned court below within a period of four weeks from today, on furnishing personal bond to the satisfaction of the Additional Chief Brij Mohan Ray vs The State Of Bihar on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/197089393/
1 Judicial Magistrate-III, Patna in connection with Rajeev Nagar P.S. Case No. 87 of 2019, subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr. P.C. (Arvind Srivastava, J) utkarsh/-
